meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

copy.tagline: 通过 DeltaChat 集成加密邮件通信
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加端到端加密的邮件聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate encrypted email messaging via DeltaChat
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add end-to-end encrypted email chat to your app

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把 DeltaChat 邮件加密通道装进 NanoClaw:复制适配器文件、注册导入、安装依赖、构建并测试,然后指导填写邮箱凭据、重启服务并生成邀请链接。
howto.when: 当用户要求为 NanoClaw 添加 DeltaChat 频道(如 setup 流程中需要接入邮件加密消息)时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 NanoClaw 接入 DeltaChat
say.note: 开始执行适配器安装与注册。

say.text: 添加 DeltaChat 频道并配置我的邮箱凭据
say.note: 会引导填写 .env 中的 DC_* 变量。

say.text: 重启服务让 DeltaChat 通道生效
say.note: 执行 systemd/launchd 重启命令。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will integrate the DeltaChat email-encrypted channel into NanoClaw: copying adapter files, registering the import, installing dependencies, building and testing, then guiding through email credential setup, service restart, and invite-link generation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a DeltaChat channel to NanoClaw, e.g., during setup when an email-based encrypted messaging integration is needed.

say_en.text: Help me connect NanoClaw to DeltaChat.
Add the DeltaChat channel and configure my email credentials.
say_en.note: Will guide filling DC_* vars in .env.

say_en.text: Restart the service so the DeltaChat channel takes effect.
